_note: Hand-authored overlay for the prop-contract pilot. Judgment that is NOT derivable from .d.ts: props agents wrongly invent, observed mistakes (wrong → why → right), and a minimal correct example. Merged with the generated component-api.json by component name.

commonMistakes.why: Button has no "icon" size; sizes are default|sm|lg. Icon buttons use the boolean `icon` prop.

commonMistakes.wrong: <Form watch={…}> or passing individual react-hook-form methods
commonMistakes.why: <Form> is the FormProvider — spread the WHOLE useForm() object, do not pass methods one by one.

Form.minimalExample:
const form = useForm<{ name: string }>();
<Form {...form}>
  <form onSubmit={form.handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
    <FormField control={form.control} name="name" render={({ field }) => (
      <FormItem><FormLabel>Name</FormLabel><FormControl><Input {...field} /></FormControl><FormMessage /></FormItem>
    )} />
  </form>
</Form>

commonMistakes.why: render is required and receives ({ field }); control and name are required.
useFormField() needs FormItem context or it throws at runtime.

commonMistakes.wrong: searchKey that is not a real column id
commonMistakes.why: searchKey must match a column accessorKey/id, or filtering silently does nothing.

commonMistakes.wrong: using plain Table for sortable/filterable/paged data

DataTable.minimalExample:
import { DataTable } from "@core/core-ui/data-table";
<DataTable columns={columns} data={data} searchKey="name" />

commonMistakes.why: There is no activeStep prop — it leaks onto a DOM node. The current step is `value` (number); each StepperItem takes `step` (number).

Stepper.minimalExample:
import { Stepper, StepperItem, StepperIndicator, StepperLabel } from "@core/core-ui/stepper";
<Stepper value={current}>
  <StepperItem step={0}><StepperIndicator /><StepperLabel>Details</StepperLabel></StepperItem>
</Stepper>

commonMistakes.wrong: import ReactECharts from "echarts-for-react" (or using echarts directly)
commonMistakes.why: Use ChartContainer — it owns theming and the echarts instance (fm-chart-1).

ChartContainer.minimalExample:
import { ChartContainer } from "@core/core-ui/chart";
<ChartContainer height={300} option={{ xAxis: { type: "category", data: months }, yAxis: { type: "value" }, series: [{ type: "line", data: values }] }} />

commonMistakes.wrong: using Dialog for an edge/side panel
commonMistakes.why: Sheet slides in from an edge; Dialog is a centered modal.

Sheet.minimalExample:
import { Sheet, SheetTrigger, SheetContent, SheetHeader, SheetTitle } from "@core/core-ui/sheet";
<Sheet><SheetTrigger asChild><Button>Open</Button></SheetTrigger><SheetContent side="right"><SheetHeader><SheetTitle>Edit</SheetTitle></SheetHeader></SheetContent></Sheet>

commonMistakes.why: DialogContent must live inside Dialog (with DialogTrigger or controlled open).

Dialog.minimalExample:
import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle } from "@core/core-ui/dialog";
<Dialog><DialogTrigger asChild><Button>Open</Button></DialogTrigger><DialogContent><DialogHeader><DialogTitle>Title</DialogTitle></DialogHeader></DialogContent></Dialog>
